verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents its own 'smart invoice scanning technology' that can automate entry of recipient details for payments. It also describes invoice approval flows and MCP access to review bill pay invoices, which supports a review step before payment. The scanning claim is a single thin marketing line, though, and it isn't explicitly described as AI. Missing for 10: detail on what fields are extracted and how accurately, documented intake of incoming bills (e.g., email forwarding), an explicit AI/extraction description, a documented pre-payment review of auto-filled fields, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI read incoming bills and auto-populate payment details for my review

citations.quote: Enter recipient details or automate the process through smart invoice scanning technology.
